prdTicketRef: SCH-012 (PRD header). The pipeline ticket is SH-12.
brownfieldFindings: prisma/schema.prisma has no Announcement, AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementAttachment or AnnouncementRead models and no AnnouncementStatus or AudienceType enums. They need a new migration, plus back-relations on User (authored announcements, reads) and FileObject (announcement attachments).

The audience-resolution data already exists: User.status/archivedAt (ACTIVE, non-archived filter), StudentProfile.gradeLevelId, ParentStudentLink(parentId, studentId), Section.homeroomTeacherId and gradeLevelId, SectionMember(studentId, academicYearId), Course.teacherId + coTeacherIds String[] + sectionId + academicYearId, and Enrollment.status (ACTIVE).

File access registry: src/server/files/access.ts exports registerFileAccess(context, resolver). Built-in contexts are registered in src/server/files/contexts.ts. Resolvers receive null for anonymous callers, which is what the public-announcement case needs.
Notification types live in src/server/notifications/types.ts with {category, mandatoryInApp, ...}. COMMUNICATION is already a category. notify() is in src/server/notifications/notify.ts.
The 'generic-notification' email template is already registered in src/server/email/render.ts.

The maintenance run is POST /api/internal/email/dispatch (CRON_SECRET-gated). It calls dispatchEmails, sendDueReminders and the quiz maintenance passes. publishDueAnnouncements() should be added there, following src/server/quiz/maintenance.ts (batched and idempotent).
src/config/public-routes.ts has PUBLIC_API_PATHS. '/api/public/news' must be added (FR-8 / API table).

src/config/course-tabs.ts is where the course 'Announcements' tab goes (FR-5.4). src/config/navigation.ts NavItem has no badge field, so the unread-count badge needs a small extension. src/components/NotificationBell/NotificationBell.tsx already shows a Badge-and-poll pattern to reuse.

Shared components are in src/components/<Name>/ (MarkdownEditor, MarkdownView, FileUpload, FileList, DataTable, ConfirmDialog, UserPicker, EmptyState, PageHeader, StatCard, Toast/useToast), not in src/components/shared/ as the platform context says. Reuse them where they are.
src/server/csv.ts already handles CSV export (FR-6.2). src/server/rate-limit.ts exists, but the 24h reminder throttle is a per-announcement business rule, not a rate limit.

Seed personas: Tom (teacher@), Sam (student@), Pat (parent@). Course lookups by code (MATH-7A) go through findCourse and skip when the course is missing. Neither prisma/seed.ts nor the scripts create 7A/7B/6A sections or ParentStudentLink rows. Seed announcements that target Grade 7, MATH-7A or 6A must follow the same skip-if-missing pattern.

functionalRequirements.description: Add enums AnnouncementStatus (DRAFT, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED) and AudienceType (SCHOOL, STAFF, ROLE, GRADE_LEVEL, SECTION, COURSE), plus the models Announcement, AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementAttachment and AnnouncementRead (composite PK announcementId+userId), exactly as specified, in a new prisma migration.
Validate title ≤ 150 chars and body (Markdown) ≤ 20,000 chars in a shared Zod schema at src/lib/validators/announcements.ts.
functionalRequirements.source: FR-1 Data model (field comments); Platform Context › Validation

functionalRequirements.description: resolveAudienceUserIds(audiences) in src/server/announcements/audience.ts returns the deduplicated ids of ACTIVE, non-archived users. SCHOOL = everyone, STAFF = ADMIN + TEACHER, ROLE = users whose role is refId.

GRADE_LEVEL audience: students whose profile grade level is refId (includeStudents), their linked parents (includeParents), and teachers of current-year courses in sections of that grade level (includeTeachers).

SECTION audience: section members, their parents, the homeroom teacher and the teachers of the section's courses, each gated by the same include flags. 'Section members' is taken to mean current academic-year SectionMember rows.
COURSE audience: students with ACTIVE enrollment, their parents, and the course teacher plus co-teachers (Course.coTeacherIds), each gated by the include flags.
isUserInAudience(user, audiences) answers membership for one user through targeted SQL/Prisma joins, without loading every recipient. It must agree with resolveAudienceUserIds.
functionalRequirements.source: FR-2.2; NFR Performance; Test Requirements › Integration

functionalRequirements.description: The audience service is generic (no announcement-specific coupling) so PRD-14 calendar events can reuse it.
ADMIN may target any audience type and set isPublic.

TEACHER may target only COURSE audiences for courses they manage (teacher or co-teacher) and SECTION audiences for the section they homeroom. Any other audience, or isPublic=true, is rejected server-side with 403 FORBIDDEN.
STUDENT and PARENT cannot create announcements (403).
Authors may edit their own announcements, and admins may edit or archive any. Archiving sets status ARCHIVED. When an admin changes someone else's announcement, write an AuditLog row through audit().
functionalRequirements.source: FR-3.4; API table (archive); Platform Context › audit()

functionalRequirements.description: The composer pages /announcements/new and /announcements/[id]/edit have: title, body (the PRD-08 MarkdownEditor), optional cover image, attachments, an audience builder (rows of type → entity picker → include students/parents/teachers checkboxes), pinned, requires acknowledgement, public (admins only), publish now / schedule (publishAt) / save draft, and an expiry date.

A live recipient count next to the audience builder ('Will reach 412 people: 180 students, 214 parents, 18 teachers'), computed by POST /api/announcements/preview-audience, which returns counts by role.
Publishing (now or scheduled) with zero resolved recipients is refused with a VALIDATION_ERROR. Drafts may have zero recipients.
Scheduling sets status SCHEDULED with publishAt. An announcement becomes visible once publishAt <= now, evaluated at read time, so a cron is not needed for visibility.

Feed /announcements (GET /api/announcements) for all roles: published, non-expired announcements whose audience includes the user. Up to 3 pinned show first, then newest. Unread items show a dot. Filter tabs: All / Unread / Requires acknowledgement. Paginated per platform conventions.
A feed card shows the cover thumbnail, title, author and role, date, audience chips (e.g. 'Grade 7 · Parents'), a 200-character plain-text excerpt and the attachment count.
Detail /announcements/[id] (GET /api/announcements/:id; allowed for audience members, the author and ADMIN) shows the full sanitised body and attachments, and upserts AnnouncementRead.readAt on open.

When requiresAck is set, an 'I acknowledge' button calls POST /api/announcements/:id/ack (audience members only) and stores acknowledgedAt. The button then reads 'Acknowledged on 14 Sep', shown in the school timezone.
A course 'Announcements' tab (registered in src/config/course-tabs.ts) lists announcements whose audience includes that course (GET /api/announcements?courseId=).
In the parent feed, an item with a grade, section or course audience is labelled with the linked child it relates to ('For Sam').

Manage view /announcements/manage (GET /api/announcements/manage): teachers see the announcements they authored, admins see all, including expired and archived ones. Columns: status, audience summary, reach, read %, and acknowledged % when required.

A per-announcement stats page (GET /api/announcements/:id/stats; author or ADMIN) shows counts and a recipient table (name, role, read at, acknowledged at) with Unread / Not acknowledged filters and CSV export via ?format=csv.

'Send reminder' (POST /api/announcements/:id/remind; author or ADMIN) notifies only recipients who have not acknowledged (type announcement.reminder). A second reminder within 24 hours is refused. A refused reminder returns 429 RATE_LIMITED or 409 CONFLICT; the architect picks one.

Register the notification type announcement.published (category COMMUNICATION, default email true, mandatoryInApp true when requiresAck) and the type announcement.reminder in src/server/notifications/types.ts.

Send announcement.published exactly once, when the announcement first becomes visible: immediately on publish-now, or by publishDueAnnouncements() in the maintenance run for scheduled ones. notifiedAt is set atomically to keep this idempotent.
The email uses the generic-notification template with the title, the first 300 characters of the body as plain text, and a 'Read announcement' button linking to /announcements/[id].
Editing the audience after publish does not re-notify.

Register file access context 'announcement'. Access is allowed for audience members, the author and admins, and for everyone, including anonymous users, when the announcement is isPublic and published. This covers the cover image and attachments.
getPublicNews({ page }) returns public, published, non-expired announcements. GET /api/public/news exposes it without authentication and is added to public-routes.ts.
Add an 'Announcements' sidebar entry for all roles, with an unread count badge from GET /api/announcements/unread-count.
TEACHER and ADMIN see a 'New announcement' button on the feed.

REST endpoints exactly as listed in the PRD API table: GET/POST /api/announcements, GET unread-count, GET/PATCH /:id, POST /:id/archive, POST /:id/ack, POST preview-audience, GET manage, GET /:id/stats, POST /:id/remind, GET /api/public/news. Each uses thin Zod handlers and the platform response/error shapes.
functionalRequirements.source: API table; Platform Context › Code layout

functionalRequirements.description: Seed 6 announcements: school-wide welcome (pinned, public), Grade 7 parents field-trip consent (requires ack), MATH-7A homework club (by Tom), staff meeting (STAFF), sports day notice scheduled 2 days ahead (public), and an expired exam timetable notice.
Services go in src/server/announcements/ (announcements-service.ts and audience.ts), following the PRD-05 feature-subdirectory precedent.
functionalRequirements.source: FR-2 heading; Platform Context › Code layout

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: UI component rule: use only Material UI (@mui/material 9.5.0, icons, MUI X). Look up every component through the mui-mcp server (useMuiDocs → fetchDocs) before use. No banned libraries (Tailwind, shadcn, Radix, notistack, etc.). Toasts go through useToast(), confirmations use Dialog, pickers use Autocomplete, and Markdown renders to MUI components. If mui-mcp is unreachable, report a blocker. QA must verify there are no banned imports.
Performance: the feed query for a parent with 3 children returns in under 200 ms with 2,000 announcements. Membership is resolved through SQL joins on audience rows, never by loading all recipients.
Security: every handler and server page enforces access server-side. A teacher who submits a SCHOOL audience gets 403.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: NFR 2 Security; AC-3; Platform Context › requireRole

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Security: sanitise Markdown bodies as in PRD-08 (react-markdown + rehype-sanitize through the existing MarkdownView), including excerpts and the plain-text email body.
Accessibility: unread dots carry screen-reader text 'Unread'.

Privacy: users only see announcements whose audience includes them. Detail, ack, file and stats endpoints return 403/404 to non-members. Scheduled and expired items are hidden from feeds and from non-author detail.
Store timestamps in UTC. publishAt, expiresAt and the 'Acknowledged on' date are interpreted and displayed in SchoolSettings.timezone.

Brownfield: reuse the existing services and components (notify, audit, registerFileAccess, csv, MarkdownEditor/View, FileUpload, DataTable, UserPicker, useToast). Don't re-scaffold or rename existing routes or models. Keep lint, typecheck and existing tests passing.
Scope: no comments or reactions, no translation, no SMS. Don't implement the PRD-18 public website pages; only expose getPublicNews and /api/public/news.

Tests: unit tests for audience resolution per type and flag combination and for teacher permission rules. Integration tests that isUserInAudience matches resolveAudienceUserIds for every seed user (property-style) and that scheduled publish notification is idempotent. A Playwright e2e test: admin composes a targeted announcement with ack, parent reads and acknowledges, admin sees stats.
Use logger from src/lib/logger.ts, never console.log, in new code. The existing seed file's console.log convention may stay as it is.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin targets GRADE_LEVEL Grade 7 with parents only. The preview shows only Grade 7 parents, and after publishing only they see it.
Tom targets COURSE MATH-7A. MATH-7A students, their parents and Tom see it. A 7B student does not.
Tom targets SCHOOL via the API and gets 403.
An announcement scheduled for 07:00 tomorrow is invisible until 07:00. Its notification is sent once, by the first maintenance run after 07:00.
With requiresAck, 50 recipients and 30 acknowledged: stats show 60% acknowledged, the reminder notifies exactly 20 users, and a second reminder within 24h is refused.
An expired announcement is absent from feeds but present in the author's manage view.
GET /api/public/news returns public announcements without auth and omits non-public ones.
Pat has Sam (7A) and a child in 6A. A 6A section announcement is labelled 'For <6A child's name>' in Pat's feed.

questions: FR-5: Do 'section members' mean only current academic-year SectionMember rows?
FR-15: Can a draft be saved with zero recipients, with the zero-recipient refusal applied only at publish/schedule time?

FR-25: Should a refused second reminder within 24h return 429 RATE_LIMITED or 409 CONFLICT? And how is the last reminder time stored (a new column such as Announcement.lastRemindedAt, or derived from Notification rows)?
FR-1 vs FR-25: The FR-1 schema has no field for the reminder throttle. Is adding a nullable column acceptable?
FR-17: If more than 3 announcements are pinned, do the extra ones fall back into the newest-first list?
AC-8 / seed: The seed creates no 6A section and no ParentStudentLink rows. Should the seed (or the e2e/integration fixture) create the 6A child linked to Pat?
FR-12: Can an author edit an announcement after it is archived, or is archive terminal?
unresolved: FR-5 section membership scope: defaulting to current academic year.
FR-15 draft with zero recipients: defaulting to allowed; refusal only on publish/schedule.
FR-25 reminder throttle status code and storage: architect decides. Suggested: a nullable lastRemindedAt column and 429 RATE_LIMITED.
FR-17 overflow pins: defaulting to the extra pinned items flowing into newest-first order.
AC-8 fixture: the test fixture creates the 6A child and the Pat link if the seed lacks them.
FR-12 archived edits: defaulting to archive being terminal for authors, with admins still able to edit.
